input.command: git diff -- impl.ts artifacts/notes.md && git status --short

cat > /opt/cursor/artifacts/code-tour-author-handoff.md <<'EOF'
<decision>
The implementation treats the refundable amount as the remaining payment balance, permits pending payments to preserve the existing support workflow, and returns conventional HTTP outcomes with a generated UUID. It keeps the function pure rather than mutating the payment.

<risk>
Review the chosen status/error mapping and the interpretation that an omitted amount means the remaining balance after prior refunds.

<verified>
Ran `node smoke.ts`, a Node assertion matrix covering success and rejection paths, and `node --check impl.ts`.
EOF
git add impl.ts artifacts && git commit -m "Implement ticket" && git push -u origin HEAD
